rules.name: rrr-mtm-order-probe-all-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT row_number() OVER () AS fn_order, p.trade_id, p.contract_number, p.client_code, p.product_code, p.derivative_type, p.opt_periodicity, p.is_premium_paid, p.active_lots::text AS active_lots, p.mult_factor::text AS mult_factor, p.original_premium::text AS original_premium, p.nc_factor::text AS nc_factor, p.fx_nc_factor::text AS fx_nc_factor, p.mtm_usd::text AS mtm_usd, p.mtm_nc::text AS mtm_nc, p.mkt_value_usd::text AS mkt_value_usd, p.mkt_value_nc::text AS mkt_value_nc, p.fixing_date, p.counterparty_parent, booking.structure_name FROM opera.fn_client_statement_position_rows_v2( (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), CAST(:bu AS text), CAST(:valueDate AS date), (SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT trim(m.client_code)) FROM opera.client_master_data m WHERE m.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND m.business_unit = :bu AND length(trim(m.client_code)) = 3)) p LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (lower(trim(b.contract_number))) lower(trim(b.contract_number)) AS contract_key, b.structure_name FROM opera.client_statement_booking_order_information_table b WHERE b.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND b.business_unit = :bu ORDER BY lower(trim(b.contract_number)), b.updated_timestamp DESC NULLS LAST) booking ON booking.contract_key = lower(trim(p.contract_number))

SELECT c.trade_id, c.contract_number, c.derivative_type, c.is_premium_paid, c.premium_paid_usd::text AS premium_paid_usd, c.premium_paid_nc::text AS premium_paid_nc, c.mtm_usd::text AS mtm_usd, c.mtm_nc::text AS mtm_nc, c.mkt_value_usd::text AS mkt_value_usd FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.value_date = :valueDate AND c.contract_number IS NOT NULL

SELECT d.* FROM opera.client_dripping_table d WHERE d.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND d.business_unit = :bu AND d.value_date = :valueDate
